name: web-botanical-site-laptop-on-mossy-rock-in-morning-mist
title: Botanical biotech site on a laptop resting on a mossy rock in misty light
whatItIs: A laptop sits on a lichen-covered rock among wildflowers in hazy golden light. Its screen mirrors the scene with a misty meadow hero and a glass sphere holding a plant. Tiny captions in the top corners give date, discipline and author.
whatItMeans: Serene, premium and organic; the screen and setting share one landscape so the site feels inseparable from nature.
techniques: Stage the device inside the same environment its hero image depicts.
Use shallow depth of field and backlight for a dreamy glow.
Keep credits as tiny centred text at the top.
Match screen colours to the surrounding palette.

vocabulary.definition: A mockup setting that repeats the imagery on the screen.
Soft light from behind that creates a glowing mist.
A device placed in a real or rendered setting.
Tiny text naming date, type and author.
